analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free due to re-entrant destruction during object dumping. In php_var_dump(IS_OBJECT case), it obtains the object class entry and iterates properties from zend_get_properties_for(), then recursively dumps nested values. During this recursion, userland destructors can run (here via nested objects and unset in __destruct), freeing an object that is still being traversed. php_var_dump then continues using stale zval/object data (e.g., Z_OBJCE_P(struc) / property values) without pinning the dumped object/properties with a stable refcount across the whole dump, leading to UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires var_dump() on an object graph where recursive dumping invokes userland code that mutates/frees related objects during shutdown/destructor reentrancy. In the PoC, Node::__destruct calls var_dump($this) and then unset($this->children); children contain other Node objects with back-references, so unsetting/dtor cascade frees an object while php_var_dump is still iterating/dereferencing it. The harness executes attacker-controlled PHP script, so crafted objects + __destruct side effects are sufficient.
